title: Maternal smoking, birth weight and infant mortality
question: What is the total causal effect of maternal smoking during pregnancy on infant mortality, and should the analysis condition on birth weight?
source: Hernández-Díaz S, Schisterman EF, Hernán MA. The birth weight "paradox" uncovered? Am J Epidemiol. 2006;164(11):1115-20. Structure as drawn in the paper's causal diagram: an unmeasured cause of low birth weight (such as birth defects) also affects mortality.
